criteria.reason: Admits it cannot quote 2027 premiums, but fabricates figures (+CHF 200–400/month, CHF 5–10/month) and premium-difference claims.
Franchise concept roughly conveyed, but Selbstbehalt wrongly limited to hospital stays, CHF 700 cap and franchise levels omitted, 'no franchise' option invented.
Recommends CHF 2,500 and lists calculators, but gives no break-even method and decides for the user.
Points to comparis, moneyland and Helsana's calculator, but never the official FOPH (priminfo) premium comparison.

factual_errors: No 'no franchise' option exists for adults; minimum franchise is CHF 300 (levels 300/500/1000/1500/2000/2500).
Selbstbehalt is 10% of costs above the franchise for all services, capped at CHF 700/year for adults; response limits it to hospital stays and omits the cap.
KVG basic-insurance premiums cannot be individually discounted; '+CHF 200–400/month', 'CHF 5–10/month' and home/auto bundling claims are invented.
A new insurer does not automatically cancel the current basic-insurance policy; the insured must give notice themselves.
summary: Admits unknown 2027 premiums but invents figures, misexplains the Selbstbehalt (no CHF 700 cap, hospital-only), directly recommends CHF 2,500, and omits the official FOPH comparison.
